abyssal nexus.name: Abyssal Nexus
abyssal nexus.confirmation: Confirm fairy ring DIP access, or the Enter the Abyss approach (Wilderness, skull and Prayer-drain risk).

ardougne sewers.name: Ardougne Sewers
ardougne sewers.confirmation: Confirm the relevant sewer section: Clock Tower valve, Hazeel Cult route or Ratcatchers basement; they are not interchangeable.

callisto's den.name: Callisto's Den
callisto's den.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Callisto boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

glarial's tomb.name: Glarial's Tomb
glarial's tomb.confirmation: Requires Glarial's pebble and an unarmed, unarmoured, rune-free entry method.

hunter's end.name: Hunter's End
hunter's end.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Callisto boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.confirmation: Requires showing a fire cape for Mor Ul Rek and sacrificing one to unlock the Inferno; use a full-wave method.

melzar's maze.name: Melzar's Maze
melzar's maze.confirmation: Requires the maze key from Dragon Slayer I and the correct coloured-door route.

shadow dungeon.name: Shadow Dungeon
shadow dungeon.confirmation: Requires an equipped ring of visibility or ring of shadows for the ladder.

silk chasm.name: Silk Chasm
silk chasm.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Venenatis boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

skavid caves.name: Skavid Caves
skavid caves.confirmation: Bring the skavid map and a light source; the map is obtained during Watchtower.

skeletal tomb.name: Skeletal Tomb
skeletal tomb.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Vet'ion boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

tear of the soul.name: Tear of the Soul
tear of the soul.confirmation: The rowboat must first be built, or use the 61 Sailing mooring route with an inoculation station.

vatrachos island.name: Vatrachos Island
vatrachos island.confirmation: Confirm the built rowboat from Stonecutter Outpost, or the 46 Sailing mooring route.

vet'ion's rest.name: Vet'ion's Rest
vet'ion's rest.confirmation: Requires medium Wilderness diary OR a specific Vet'ion boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

web chasm.name: Web Chasm
web chasm.confirmation: Requires hard Wilderness diary OR a specific Venenatis boss task, plus the shared 50,000 coin entry fee.

wyrmscraig.name: Wyrmscraig
wyrmscraig.confirmation: Confirm the first 62 Sailing visit or the unlocked Fallen From Grace teleport route.

ynysdail.name: Ynysdail
ynysdail.confirmation: Confirm 73 Sailing mooring with an adamant keel, or the built Gwenith rowboat after Song of the Elves.

ynysdail cavern.name: Ynysdail Cavern
ynysdail cavern.confirmation: Confirm 73 Sailing mooring with an adamant keel, or the built Gwenith rowboat after Song of the Elves.
